Outer ellipse is a schematic observational envelope without rigid material edge. All thirteen ring-shaped markers identify stellar population, not holes, extra galaxies, Braille or Index line dots as additional stars. Central stellar marker is present: no giant empty central hole, spiral arms/bar or nested solid shells inferred from source501 dark centre.
